messages.subject: Rashid — protective ET3 for review
messages.plaintextBody:
Patricia,

Draft ET3 grounds of resistance attached for your review before we file on 17 June. It denies the claims and reserves the s.111A inadmissibility point, but we'll also write to the tribunal confirming settlement so this should never be contested. Grateful for any comments today.

Tom

--

T +44 (0)20 7946 0521
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
